name: Nagato (Japan, 1954–2005)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Nagato city emblem in white: a ring open at the top with two curled ends, enclosing a stylised mountain of horizontal strokes.
history: Earlier flag of Nagato city in Yamaguchi Prefecture, used from 1954 to 2005.

features.role: Nagato city emblem — a ring open at the top with two curled ends, enclosing a stylised mountain of horizontal strokes
